candidate.title: scATAC-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina schematic, comprising the upper Cell index and middle Microfluidics scATAC-Seq rows. They are distinct implementations of single-cell chromatin accessibility measurement. The partially visible Drop-ChIP row below and residual labels from the row above are neighboring poster material, not scATAC-Seq alternatives. Left-hand Single cell/chromatin cartoons illustrate the biological target; the operational routes start at Cell suspension. Three wells per indexing round are representative depicted branches, not a claim about experimental well count. The microfluidic row shows one representative cell route that is repeated to produce the libraries pooled at the right. Implementation-level clarifications are restricted to Cusanovich et al. (PMID 25953818) for Cell index and Buenrostro et al. (PMID 26083756) for Microfluidics. Sequencing is the paper-supported interpretation of the final DNA libraries, not an additional operation drawn in these two rows. No equivalence or interchangeability of the complete protocols is asserted.
